description.en: Literature watch for DeepSeek Harness: save named Crossref bibliographic queries with time windows, run them with a bounded client, keep a seen-DOI store so repeated runs return only genuinely new items, and render a Markdown digest plus SARIF.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的文献监测：保存带时间窗的命名 Crossref 检索式，用有界客户端运行，并记录已见 DOI，使重复运行只返回真正的新条目，输出 Markdown 摘要与 SARIF。
